# StayGreen Compliance

> StayGreen is contractor risk management for independent oil & gas producers. Every contractor and subcontractor is verified at two levels — company level (signed MSA, COI verified for additional insured and waiver-of-subrogation wording, W-9, EMR) and worker level (H2S, DISA, and every other required training card, checked on every hand before anyone rolls). Work orders build the crew, crews stage from a text link with no vendor logins, and every tailgate is signed on the phone with time and GPS — producing a signed JSA, site manifest, and closeout packet retained 7+ years and audit-ready.

## What StayGreen does
- Two-level contractor verification for producers: company paperwork (MSA, COI wording, W-9, EMR) and worker training (H2S, DISA, OSHA 10, PEC SafeLand, operator site orientation)
- Work orders with awarded primes: attach the contractors already awarded the job; each builds their crew from their own bench
- Subcontractor staging via text links — no vendor logins or app downloads; every hand checked live against the producer's required training before anyone rolls
- JSA & site manifest: one sheet for the contractor's crew, their subs, and the producer's own hands; signatures on the phone stamped with time and GPS; signed PDFs and closeout packets on demand
- AI parsing of training cards from photos or PDFs; COI tracking including Additional Insured, Waiver of Subrogation, Primary & Non-Contributory wording; auto-drafted broker request emails
- 7+ year retention of every JSA, manifest, and clearance snapshot — OSHA- and MSA-audit ready

## Who it's for
Independent oil & gas producers who hire contractors and carry the liability but don't have a contractor-management department — plus the contractors and safety consultants who work with them (StayGreen keeps contractor records green and serves as a white-label AI back office for consultants).

## Key facts
- Website: https://staygreencompliance.ai
- Portal: https://app.staygreencompliance.ai
- Service area: Permian Basin, Texas, New Mexico, Oklahoma, and US-wide
